scenes.stage_direction: Rain, interrupted sleep and a missing infant. Preserve the distinction between Amara's true sighting and the unexplained means of entry.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The message mentions the cupboard beside the nursery.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: It is behind the door. You cannot see it from the garden.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Then its sender knows something about the inside of the house.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Can that take us to him?

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: It gives us a claim we can test. I won't pretend it gives us a location yet.

metadata.episode: A continuing rescue mystery; the final clue opens the next episode.
